summary: New Email drafts stay on the creating agent's Mission Control list until sent or discarded. Adds compose_state, work_item_id and sent_email_message_id to outbound_email_drafts, outbound_draft_id to email_messages (the sent email links back to its draft), and a community FK (NOT VALID) on outbound_email_drafts.community_id. Additive only: no row is changed and nothing is sent.

preflight.name: outbound_email_drafts does not have compose_state yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'outbound_email_drafts' AND column_name = 'compose_state'

preflight.name: email_messages does not have outbound_draft_id yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'email_messages' AND column_name = 'outbound_draft_id'

preflight.name: work_items exists (Mission Control tasks)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'work_items'

expected_changes: outbound_email_drafts: new nullable columns compose_state, work_item_id, sent_email_message_id.
Foreign keys: drafts -> communities (NOT VALID), drafts -> work_items, drafts -> email_messages, email_messages -> outbound_email_drafts.

verify.name: draft columns exist
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'outbound_email_drafts' AND column_name IN ('compose_state', 'work_item_id', 'sent_email_message_id')

verify.name: sent email links back to its draft
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'email_messages_outbound_draft_fkey'

verify.name: drafts carry a community FK
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'outbound_email_drafts_community_fkey'
